column3: NKJV includes “the multitudes” and “came together to Him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “went before them.”
NKJV names “Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “having gone out, He saw.”
NKJV has “buy themselves bread; for they have nothing to eat,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “buy themselves something to eat.”
Close to the Greek; “Take courage” is rendered “Be of good cheer.”
NKJV includes “and marveled,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “they were amazed.”
